# Corner-based background probes: each quadrant = 2x2 mirror tiling of the 56x56 corner patch
def bg_corner(arr, w=56):
    def tile(p, flip_h_first, flip_v_first):
        # p is the corner patch in its original orientation; build 2w x 2w with p at the outer corner
        ph = p[:, ::-1]; pv = p[::-1]; pvh = p[::-1, ::-1]
        return p, ph, pv, pvh
    out = np.zeros_like(arr)
    h = 2*w
    TL = arr[:w, :w]; TR = arr[:w, -w:]; BL = arr[-w:, :w]; BR = arr[-w:, -w:]
    # top-left quadrant: patch at outer corner (0,0)
    out[:w, :w] = TL; out[:w, w:h] = TL[:, ::-1]; out[w:h, :w] = TL[::-1]; out[w:h, w:h] = TL[::-1, ::-1]
    # top-right quadrant: patch at outer corner (0, -w)
    out[:w, -w:] = TR; out[:w, h:h+w] = TR[:, ::-1]; out[w:h, -w:] = TR[::-1]; out[w:h, h:h+w] = TR[::-1, ::-1]
    # bottom-left
    out[-w:, :w] = BL; out[-w:, w:h] = BL[:, ::-1]; out[h:h+w, :w] = BL[::-1]; out[h:h+w, w:h] = BL[::-1, ::-1]
    # bottom-right
    out[-w:, -w:] = BR; out[-w:, h:h+w] = BR[:, ::-1]; out[h:h+w, -w:] = BR[::-1]; out[h:h+w, h:h+w] = BR[::-1, ::-1]
    return out

def reader_ablate(block, U, c, alpha=1.0):
    """Mean-ablate directions (rows of U, orthonormal) at the input of block.conv1.
    conv1.weight' = W - alpha (W U^T) U ; bn1.running_mean' = rm - alpha (W U^T) c  (c = balanced mean coordinates along U)."""
    Wc = load_original(f'{block}.conv1.weight').double()          # [512, 2048,1,1]
    W2 = Wc[:,:,0,0]
    Ut = torch.tensor(U, dtype=torch.float64)                      # [k, 2048]
    WU = W2 @ Ut.T                                                 # [512, k]
    Wn = W2 - alpha * WU @ Ut
    rm = load_original(f'{block}.bn1.running_mean').double()
    rmn = rm - alpha * (WU @ torch.tensor(c, dtype=torch.float64))
    save_edit(f'{block}.conv1.weight', Wn[:,:,None,None].float())
    save_edit(f'{block}.bn1.running_mean', rmn.float())
    return float((Wn-W2).norm()/W2.norm()), float((rmn-rm).norm()/rm.norm())

# fc-only edit F0 with the neutrality rule expressed through statistics: margin(mean bird-free probe feature) = 0. Fold A version for cross-fit.
def build_F0(Xrows_mask, probe_mask, alpha=1.0, save=True):
    """fc-only edit from ORIGINAL-model avgpool statistics: remove unit bg mean-difference direction (rows in mask) from fc;
       set fc.bias so that the land/water-balanced mean probe feature vector (probes in probe_mask) has margin 0 and its logit sum is unchanged."""
    mu_ = gmeans(X, g, Xrows_mask); gam_ = effects(mu_)[0]; u_ = unit(gam_)
    a_ref = 0.5*(XP[probe_mask & (pplace==0)].mean(0) + XP[probe_mask & (pplace==1)].mean(0))
    Wf = load_original('fc.weight').double().numpy(); bf = load_original('fc.bias').double().numpy()
    Wn = Wf - alpha*np.outer(Wf@u_, u_)
    # reference: after projection, shift biases so that at a_ref both logits are equal (margin 0), keeping the mean logit at a_ref as in the original model
    lo = Wn@a_ref
    mean_logit_orig = (Wf@a_ref + bf).mean()
    bn = mean_logit_orig - lo                                   # both logits equal at a_ref
    if save:
        save_edit('fc.weight', torch.tensor(Wn, dtype=torch.float32)); save_edit('fc.bias', torch.tensor(bn, dtype=torch.float32))
    return Wn, bn, u_, a_ref
